name: Farmhouse: stone and verandah
note: White board-and-batten over a limestone base, deep verandah, upper view storey to the street and east, garage under the house; living rooms, pool and outdoor room on the north courtyard.

name: Wraparound Farmhouse
note: Whitewashed brick and white board-and-batten farmhouse with a deep verandah wrapping the SW corner, three dormers, a tall fieldstone chimney, an arched timber door and carriage garage doors under the east wing; the two-storey west wing's main suite looks over the street and east, while living rooms, pool and a fireplace outdoor room open to a north courtyard terraced out to every boundary.

name: Sage and Stone
note: Two-tone farmhouse: a white board-and-batten two-storey gable (upper retreat with street and east views) and light sage gabled wings on a pale limestone base, timber portico and brass trim; modest ground-floor street windows, big glass and pool on the north courtyard, terraced out to every boundary.

name: Modern Black Barnhouse
note: Matte black board-and-batten barns with crisp no-eave gables, limewashed brick chimney and entry, a two-storey SW barn with street and east views, and a U around a north pool courtyard with an outdoor fire room and a full-width upper garden terrace.
